how_to_use: Tokens list non-FILLER tokens as TYPE(lexeme->value)[start,end); FILLER tokens are shown without spans.
ir is the canonical IR after passes O2 and O1, without span fields. Compare with CompiledQuery.to_json() minus spans.

ir_hash_prefix is the first 16 hex chars of sha256 over the canonical JSON of this example's ir without source, diagnostics and spans. Your implementation's hash must be equal for EX23 and EX24 and differ elsewhere; the exact value depends on your serialisation, so only equality is asserted.
program_unoptimized and program_optimized use the printed form of SPEC/IR specification section 'Printed form'. N = catalogue size; C = 200.
Movie titles are not listed: they depend on the downloaded MovieLens snapshot. result_properties are what tests assert.
Assumes the CORE build: semantic channel available, MMR not built, runtime and language unavailable.
